behaviorChanges: Projects may opt into a shared Git metadata branch for work declarations across independent clones, computers, and repository collaborators. Existing boolean settings keep local behavior.
Opted-in status/startup/work pickup uses bounded cached synchronization. Offline publication stays pending and never gates editing, backlog pickup, or merging.

optionalMigrations.description: Set workCoordination to an object with backend=git. Optionally choose a named remote and dedicated branch. Repository readers can see declared intent; normal Git write permissions govern publication. Run tautline work sync; the CLI reads this setting directly.

rollbackNotes: Set workCoordination back to true before downgrading to an older runtime; older adapter validators accept boolean settings only. The metadata branch remains as shared history; no source branch migration occurs.
